_comment: V6 = V5 (8B model, V2 settings) plus two code fixes for the two failure patterns that survived every version: (1) input_text into a field that already holds text clears it first (extension-field loop); (2) once every goal value is typed and a save/send button was pressed, the history line asks for status complete (never-said-done). The goal-value extraction is used only inside the done hint; there is no tracker block in the prompt and no veto (both hurt in V4).
name: v6_fixes
